item_name: Rothco Cold Weather Street Shield Gloves
item_short_desc: Rothco's Cold Weather Street Shield Gloves offer superior protection from harsh elements while providing maximum comfort and functionality. Designed with a 100% cut-resistant inner lining on the fingers and palms, these gloves ensure your hands are safeguarded against sharp objects. The outer palm is constructed from durable synthetic leather with non-skid grip material, providing a secure hold on various surfaces. The back of the hand is made from 1.5mm neoprene and nylon spandex, offering flexibility and durability.
description: Rothco's Cold Weather Street Shield Gloves offer superior protection from harsh elements while providing maximum comfort and functionality. Designed with a 100% cut-resistant inner lining on the fingers and palms, these gloves ensure your hands are safeguarded against sharp objects. The outer palm is constructed from durable synthetic leather with non-skid grip material, providing a secure hold on various surfaces. The back of the hand is made from 1.5mm neoprene and nylon spandex, offering flexibility and durability. Lined with Thermoblock insulation, these gloves provide exceptional warmth, making them ideal for extreme cold weather conditions. Whether you're working outdoors, commuting, or engaging in winter activities, Rothco's Cold Weather Street Shield Gloves are designed to keep your hands warm and protected.
